scenes.name: Out of Atlantis as the moon settles

lines.text: The moon settles and the tease of distant stars subsides
and I can see a morning ahead for me.
It looks like a morning I could believe in,
a morning where loss and life aren't so well,
ripe with sunlight that's deceptively warm.
